title: Blue extraterrestrial manifesting physically in the Scole experiment seances

tellings.quote: But he talked about being in seances where a blue extraterrestrial being would manifest. Manifest physically to the point where he could touch them.

plain: In a series of seances held in the 1990s in the English village of Scole, known as the Scole experiment, a blue extraterrestrial being is said to have appeared in solid form, so solid that a sitter could touch it. The researcher Jeffrey Mishlove tells this on the show, passing on what a man named Robin Foy, who sat in those seances, told him. If true, it would tie contact with beings from elsewhere to the world of spirit mediums.
